course: 1C:Enterprise 8 Programming — from foundations to professional development
title: Loops: repeat an action and explain every iteration
goal: Repeat a finite action, trace an accumulator and test no-iteration input.

prerequisites.text: The preceding language lesson; saving, updating and launching your own infobase.

sections.title: What repeats
paragraphs: A loop repeats instructions according to a rule. Для Номер = 1 По 3 assigns counter values 1, 2 and 3 in turn. Each value produces one body execution. КонецЦикла closes the repeated part; the message after it is displayed once after all iterations.

The body between Цикл and КонецЦикла executes for each counter value. Сообщить afterwards is outside it. Moving the message inside shows intermediate 15, 30 and 45 rather than one total: a different observation even if accumulation is unchanged.

sections.title: Trace the main example
paragraphs: Three iterations add 15 to an accumulator initialized once before the loop.

sections.title: The accumulator invariant
paragraphs: ВсегоМинут accumulates the periods already included. It starts at zero before the loop, then becomes 15, 30 and 45. The invariant “after k iterations the total is 15 × k” explains intermediate states and exposes the first incorrect step.

Initially zero periods are included and total zero. One iteration includes exactly one period. After k iterations the total therefore covers k periods of 15 minutes. If the trace first differs at iteration two, investigate that transition rather than substituting the final output.

sections.title: Counter boundaries and no iterations
paragraphs: Setting ВсегоМинут = 0 inside the body erases preceding work on every iteration and leaves 15. It is syntactically valid but wrong for the total. Identify initialization and accumulation as different operations.

Range 1..4 adds four periods; range 1..0 executes no body and retains initial zero. A bound of zero does not create an extra iteration for zero. Пока checks before its body, so an initially false condition can also produce no iterations.

sections.title: Reset in the wrong place
paragraphs: Every iteration restarts accumulation, losing preceding periods.

tables.caption: Step-by-step reasoning
rows: The error is not yet visible.

sections.title: Termination and later collections
paragraphs: The large engineering module remains supplementary. Execute this lesson’s short fragment with its own input and result. It tests in-memory arithmetic, not document persistence or database speed.

A finite Пока needs initialization, a test and a change approaching a false condition. Collections come later: Для Каждого traverses elements, but in-memory arithmetic is not automatically a document query. Прервать ends the loop; Продолжить skips the rest of one iteration.

sections.title: Check your explanation
paragraphs: I reset the accumulator each iteration. Initialize before repeating when a total is required.
Продолжить ends the loop. It advances to the next iteration; Прервать ends the loop.

selfcheck.feedback: Resetting inside erases the preceding total.

options: A separate finite copy with trace 15 → 0 → 15

selfcheck.feedback: Initialization precedes the loop, the counter advances, total 60; do not run an infinite variant.

steps.title: Preserve your preceding work
steps.where: Your infobase → Designer → configuration root → managed application module
steps.action: Close only your own Enterprise session. Open your training copy in Designer. Preserve the previous module text separately. Keep one ПриНачалеРаботыСистемы handler; replace only the preceding exercise body inside it. Do not replace modules of an unfamiliar application.

steps.expected: The intended module is open and the earlier source remains available.

steps.title: Enter this example
steps.action: Copy the main example between the existing handler declaration and КонецПроцедуры. Do not add another handler. Read the explanation and identify what changes after each line.
steps.why: Three iterations add 15 to an accumulator initialized once before the loop.
steps.expected: The exact exercise source is entered in the intended context.
steps.troubleshooting: Check ordinary quotes, semicolons and matching block endings. A syntax rejection is not execution.

steps.title: Change one condition and retain evidence
steps.where: The same module, then Enterprise mode and Nexus notes
steps.action: Change only По 3 to По 4 and execute. Then test По 0 with initial accumulator zero.
steps.why: A changed input tests understanding beyond copying the example.
steps.expected: 60 for four iterations and 0 for no iterations.
steps.troubleshooting: Do not run an infinite loop to test stopping. Use a separate finite reset-counterexample and explain where the total is first lost.
